title: General Gough
html_source:
Brigadier General Sir John Edmond Gough VC, KCB, CMG (1871 – 1915), known as Johnnie Gough, was a senior British Army officer and a recipient of the Victoria Cross in 1904, the highest award for gallantry in the face of the enemy that can be awarded to British and Commonwealth forces.
